responsibility: Defines the fundamental compiled metadata and low-level utilities for GCC’s RTL representation. It instantiates tables derived from rtl.def and insn-note definitions—such as rtx lengths, names, formats, classes, code sizes, and note-name tables—implements basic allocation/copy/size helpers for rtx and rtvec objects, tracks optional allocation statistics, and provides the runtime checking failure reporters used by ENABLE_RTL_CHECKING and related diagnostics when malformed RTL is accessed.
same_name_distinction: Instantiates the compiled RTL metadata from gcc/rtl.def and supplies low-level RTL allocation, copy, sizing, statistics, and runtime checking helpers; unlike gcc/rtl.def it is not the declarative opcode list, and unlike gcc/rtl.h it is not the central type/API declaration header.
